shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic/facial motif rendered in shallow relief
isolated figure set within a bounded field on a stone slab
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry a highly schematic anthropomorphic element — a simplified face on the small upright slab in A, and a tiny frontal figure enclosed in a rectangular niche in B — both reduced to a few linear strokes. Otherwise the depicted content diverges completely: A shows a single isolated face occupying the whole slab with no accompanying motifs, whereas B is organised into stacked horizontal registers of repeated pendant/leaf forms, a zigzag-lattice band and a plaited border framing the figure, an ordered banded scheme absent from A.
